metadata.description: Webhook integration skills for AI coding agents: provider skills (Stripe, Shopify, GitHub, and {otherProviderCount} others) plus framework-agnostic handler patterns and Hookdeck infrastructure plugins for receiving, verifying, and delivering webhooks across Express, Next.js, and FastAPI.

plugins.name: webhook-handler-patterns
plugins.description: Framework-agnostic webhook handler patterns: idempotency, error handling, retry logic, async processing for Express, Next.js, and FastAPI.

plugins.name: hookdeck-event-gateway
plugins.description: Hookdeck Event Gateway: webhook infrastructure that replaces your queue — guaranteed delivery, retries, rate limiting, replay, observability.

plugins.name: outpost
plugins.description: Send webhooks and events to user-preferred destinations (HTTP, SQS, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, EventBridge, Kafka).

plugins.name: webhook-dx-audit
plugins.description: Audit the developer experience of any platform that sends outbound webhooks or event destinations (HTTP, SQS, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub, EventBridge, Kafka) to its customers, and produce a scored review with prioritized recommendations across signing, retries, event catalog, observability, local dev, and agent readiness.

plugins.name: webhook-skills
plugins.description: Bundle of all webhook integration skills in this repo: {providerCount} provider skills (Stripe, Shopify, GitHub, and {otherProviderCount} others) for verifying signatures and handling provider-specific events, framework-agnostic webhook handler patterns covering idempotency, error handling and retries, three Hookdeck infrastructure skills for the Event Gateway and Outpost, and a webhook DX audit skill for scoring how a platform sends outbound webhooks. Each provider skill includes Express, Next.js, and FastAPI examples. Install this plugin to get all {skillCount} skills; install individual `<name>-webhooks@webhook-skills` plugins for narrower per-provider use.
